description.value: Little Saigon is a Vietnamese restaurant in Mission, BC, serving pho, vermicelli bowls, and rice plates made with no-MSG, slow-simmered broths from family recipes. It is the Mission location of a two-restaurant Fraser Valley operation, housed in a strip-mall unit with free parking. Cyclists passing through Mission will find it a convenient stop for a filling, from-scratch Vietnamese meal.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 31m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM phone number (+1-604-820-8746) and unit number (322) both match the Mission location listed on the website (#322-32555 London Ave, (604) 820-8746), confirming this record refers to the Mission restaurant. The website confirms active pickup/takeout ordering but makes no mention of cycling-specific amenities such as bike parking, water refill, or washrooms. The OSM community field says 'Chilliwack' but the address and coordinates place this business in Mission, BC.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Chilliwack' but coordinates and website address (#322-32555 London Ave) place this location in Mission, BC — a different municipality.
OSM has no full street address (only addr:unit=322); the address used here is derived from the website by cross-matching unit number and phone number to the Mission location.
Website covers two restaurant locations (Abbotsford and Mission) plus a warehouse retail site — this OSM record corresponds to the Mission restaurant only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: None of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website or OSM tags; on-the-ground verification is needed before inclusion.
